def transform(g):
    import copy
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    # find 5-cells, group into connected components
    seen=set(); comps=[]
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if g[i][j]==5 and (i,j) not in seen:
                stack=[(i,j)]; comp=[]
                while stack:
                    y,x=stack.pop()
                    if (y,x) in seen: continue
                    seen.add((y,x)); comp.append((y,x))
                    for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        ny,nx=y+dy,x+dx
                        if 0<=ny<h and 0<=nx<w and g[ny][nx]==5: stack.append((ny,nx))
                comps.append(comp)
    for comp in comps:
        ys=[p[0] for p in comp]; xs=[p[1] for p in comp]
        if len(set(ys))==1:  # horizontal bar
            r=ys[0]; c0,c1=min(xs),max(xs)
            # find adjacent colored cells below (or above) contiguous columns starting at bar
            for dr in (1,-1):
                cells=[(r+dr,c) for c in range(c0,c1+1) if 0<=r+dr<h and g[r+dr][c] not in (0,5)]
                if cells:
                    rr=r+dr
                    cols=[c for c in range(c0,c1+1) if g[rr][c] not in (0,5)]
                    if cols:
                        # vertical strip at some column, extend horizontally across bar cols
                        cc=cols[0]
                        r0,r1=rr,rr
                        while r1+1<h and g[r1+1][cc] not in (0,5): r1+=1
                        while r0-1>=0 and g[r0-1][cc] not in (0,5): r0-=1
                        for y in range(r0,r1+1):
                            v=g[y][cc]
                            for c in range(c0,c1+1):
                                out[y][c]=v
                    break
        elif len(set(xs))==1:  # vertical bar
            c=xs[0]; r0,r1=min(ys),max(ys)
            for dc in (1,-1):
                cells=[(r,c+dc) for r in range(r0,r1+1) if 0<=c+dc<w and g[r][c+dc] not in (0,5)]
                if cells:
                    cc=c+dc
                    rows=[r for r in range(r0,r1+1) if g[r][cc] not in (0,5)]
                    if rows:
                        rr=rows[0]
                        # horizontal strip: find extent
                        a=b=cc
                        while b+1<w and g[rr][b+1] not in (0,5): b+=1
                        while a-1>=0 and g[rr][a-1] not in (0,5): a-=1
                        block=[g[y][a:b+1] for y in rows]  # rows of the strip
                        # tile block vertically over bar extent
                        L=len(block)
                        for idx,y in enumerate(range(r0,r1+1)):
                            row=block[idx%L]
                            for k,cc2 in enumerate(range(a,b+1)):
                                out[y][cc2]=row[k]
                    break
    return out
